title: Design System: GALX Billing — local account workspace

headline.purpose: Billing titles at all widths; Pricing title below 640px. Billing headings break words when necessary to fit enlarged text.

headline-wide.purpose: Pricing title from 640px; Billing retains the smaller heading size.

title.purpose: Plan, prepaid credit and task section titles.

introduction.purpose: Supporting line below the page title.

control.purpose: Plan actions and task links. Billing navigation uses the same size with a 1.5rem line height.

components.name: Billing page navigation
components.description: Six canonical page links wrap on phones and become a vertical rail from 768px. The active page has a neutral wash and pale indigo text.

components.css: .ds-plan-section { font-family: var(--font-inter, Inter), -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #f4f4f5; background: #090b10; scroll-margin-top: 6rem; } .ds-plan-heading { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-plan-status { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; max-width: 42rem; color: #d4d4d8; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-plan-details { display: grid; gap: 1rem; margin: 1.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-plan-details dt { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-plan-details dd { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-plan-inclusion, .ds-plan-terms { max-width: 42rem; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-plan-inclusion { margin: 1rem 0 0; } .ds-plan-terms { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-plan-details { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); } }

components.name: Credit amount input
components.description: The labeled custom top-up amount fills the phone width and uses a compact fixed width from 640px. Guidance and invalid state remain explicit.
components.html: Enter $1–$10,000, with up to two decimal places.
components.css: .ds-credit-field { font-family: var(--font-inter, Inter), -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-credit-field label { display: block; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-credit-field input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; margin-top: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #090b10; color: #f4f4f5; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5rem; } .ds-credit-field input:focus-visible { outline-color: #a5b4fc; } .ds-credit-field p { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: #a1a1aa; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-credit-field input[aria-invalid=true] + p { color: #fca5a5; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-credit-field input { width: 12rem; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a local record for the shared `BillingWorkspace.tsx` shell, account state in `BillingProvider.tsx`, the six destinations rendered by `BillingClient.tsx`, and their plan and credit controls. The related Pro row is rendered by `src/components/pricing/PricingClient.tsx` through `src/app/pricing/page.tsx`. It extends the existing dark, compact account interface with restrained indigo actions and flat divided sections. It establishes no new product identity or global design rules.

Overview summarizes plan access and prepaid credit, then links to each billing task. The Plan page makes current access, terms, and the next action readable; Credits holds the separate balance and top-up form. Pricing presents the offer; Billing establishes the account's current status. Product terms remain authoritative in the root `PRODUCT.md` and existing public plan data; this record captures how the interface presents them.
keyCharacteristics: Dark canvas, neutral text, and restrained indigo controls.
Flat sections and plan rows divided by fine rules.
Available offer and current paid status expressed separately.
Separate billing destinations within one persistent navigation and account context.
Wrapping navigation and actions retain reading order on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Flat Sections Rule
rules.body: Keep this extension in the existing document flow, separated by rules rather than an elevated plan card.

rules.name: The Offer and Status Rule
rules.body: An available offer, a subscription record and verified Pro access are separate facts. Only the server's access result controls the Open Sites action. A checkout return URL never proves payment.

dos: **Do** retain the shared Billing and Pricing canvas, type hierarchy, dividers, and restrained indigo controls.
**Do** distinguish the available Pro offer from confirmed paid status before presenting the next action.
**Do** keep renewal, cancellation, inclusion, and separate usage terms readable beside the plan controls.
**Do** let navigation and actions wrap while preserving their reading and keyboard order.
**Do** keep six canonical billing destinations and use Overview for concise summaries and task links.
**Do** refresh both Overview summaries and preserve account drafts and filters during billing navigation.
**Do** preserve subscription management after a status failure and base known management availability on the payment profile.
**Do** keep the wallet visually and conceptually separate from plan access.
donts: **Don't** turn this local extension into a new global identity, card system, or Sites design rule.
**Don't** represent an available offer, wallet credit, or uncertain status as an active paid plan.
**Don't** replace explicit status and error text with color alone.
**Don't** copy account identifiers, actual balances, private ledger records, or review screenshots into design examples or public content.
